save.text: Episode live; Sam absent. Scanlan puppeted by Keyleth and Percy; Pike absent (in New York). Patrick Rothfuss joining via Skype. (turn 0)
Lootcrate sponsorship announced; January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% at lootcrate.com/criticalrole. (turns 4-8)
Blue Microphones provided audio equipment sponsorship; site bluemic.com mentioned. (turn 15)

Recap of events pre-dive in: Vox Machina fought Chroma Conclave; defeated Thordak; Raishan took Thordak's corpse and two eggs and fled to a distant island in the Lucidian Ocean (former Thordak lair/Opash's lair). Kerrek (Patrick) aided and joined group; team rested in Whitestone; full HP/spells recovered; Scanlan, Percy, Pike leveled. (turn 43)
Pike granted access to full cleric spell list upon leveling; discussion of picking an 8th-level spell (joke suggestions 'Power Word Kill Green Dragon'). (turns 44-53)

Loot/attunement: party inspecting treasure. Boots currently contested between Vex and Vax (Vax requests boots back). A Dragonkilling sword discussed; Dwarven Thrower warhammer found: +3, thrown (20/60), extra 1d8 damage (2d8 vs giants), returns after throw, requires attunement by a dwarf. (turns 59-97)

Dwarven Thrower warhammer attunement/requirements clarified: If you have Belt of Dwarvenkind attuned you may attune the hammer; unattuning the belt forces unattuning the hammer. Dwarven Thrower damage die is d8 (not d12); thrown range 20/60 (attacks beyond 20' at disadvantage). Requires attunement by a dwarf? (previous note said requires dwarf attunement; Matt's comments allow non-dwarf attunement only with Belt). Travis intends to attune it; Blood Axe will be relinquished. (turns 99,141-156,158-156,153-156)

Boots of Elvenkind found; do not require attunement. If Pike equips them they would replace her Sprinter's Boots (which do require attunement). Changing attuned boots is not an instantaneous action and may be cumbersome in-play. (turns 108-116,122-126)
Grog has the Dancing Sword and is attuned to it (requires attunement). Grog appears to have many weapons; Kerrek/Patrick offered to attune items if free slots available. (turns 163-169,170-174)
Dwarven Thrower attunement/details clarified: non-dwarf attunement requires Belt of Dwarvenkind; damage die is d8; thrown 20/60; Travis intends to attune and relinquish Blood Axe. (turn 156)
Grog is attuned to Dancing Sword and has many weapons; Kerrek offered to attune items if attunement slots free. (turn 169)

New curse: Grog picked up a scimitar with a built-in curse; experienced headache; blade inert afterward. Matt: source expended; Grog permanently suffers -2 to all saving throws until removed by a deity or similar magic. (turns 175-196,204-206)
Grog received 5th-level healing from Pike but headache persists; healing spell expended (turn 245).
Grog still suffers permanent -2 to all saves from cursed scimitar; curse remains unresolved (turns 175-196,245).

Pike cast Heroes' Feast (6th-level) for party: grants immunity to poison and fear, +2d10 max HP (rolled as +15 each), affects up to 12 including Kerrek, Allura, Kima, Trinket; Pike's diamond marked as spent for casting (turns 292,296-303,297-301).

Pike cast Heroes' Feast (6th-level) for party: grants immunity to poison and fear, +2d10 max HP (rolled +15 each), affected up to 12 including Kerrek, Allura, Kima, Trinket; diamond marked as spent. (turns 292,296-303,297-301)

Plan to approach Opash's cave/island: discussion whether to scry (may reveal orb to creatures who see invisibility) vs. teleport/Transport Via Plants; group leans to going in physically using Transport Via Plants (Marisha) rather than Teleport. (turns 315-323,322,375-381)
Kima and Allura arrive prepped; Kima fully armored; they ate Heroes' Feast; Kima takes a Gate Stone to deliver to Cassandra for safekeeping. (turns 359-374,384-387)
Party used Pass Without a Trace before entering Sun Tree portal; emerged into island/jungle with radial blight centered on mountain/lab. (turns 431-432,434)

Kima receives Elven boots from Percy temporarily; she tries them on but notes style mismatch; Allura leads group to Sun Tree; Keyleth to lead to Sun Tree for Transport Via Plants. (turns 393-401,401-403)
Scanlan claims plan is terrible and expresses illness; group notices his worry/frustration smell; Keyleth sniffs him; Scanlan resists singing. (turns 413-423,424-427)
Forest trees on island are long-dead/petrified: death occurred hundreds of years ago; no recent scarring observed. (turns 489-504)
Party used Pass Without a Trace; stealth rolls high across party (notable: Marisha nat20, Allura nat20; Percy's 38, Keyleth 37, Scanlan 31, Taliesin 33, Kima 24 with boots). (turns 460-485)
No dragon tracks found; only small, scattered wildlife/indigenous creature tracks. (turns 505-523)

Party identified multiple 'hollow earth' patches (magically unstable sinkhole-like areas) growing denser toward mountain; patches form 10–15 ft ovals; throwing a rock into one caused it to subside revealing empty space. (turns 575-596)
Trees nearer mountain increasingly withered/ash-like; treeline thins closer to mountain; death of trees is longstanding. (turns 545,575)
Vax and Vex scout ahead; Vax nearly stepped into a differing-texture ground patch noticed by Vex; Investigation checks: Vex 26, Vax 18. (turns 541-546)
Trees nearer mountain increasingly withered/ash-like; closer equals deader; death is rapid/in-place, not blown or leaning. (confirmed by Matt, turns 605-606)

At base of mountain: large boulder (20–30 ft) jammed into entrance ~200 ft from party; many claw-like holes pierced the rock—consistent with very large dragon claws; boulder has been placed/removed many times over years. (turns 620,623,640)

Players debate entry methods: Marisha offers to Stone Shape seam of boulder to create an opening; party considered scrying but worried about revealing them; recon/going around mountain would take ~1.5–2 hours by flying. Trap check performed earlier: no trap detected. (turns 645,656,667,664,659)
Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness by Kima/Patrick detected three dragon life forces within ~1 mile, roughly toward the mountain and below (confirmed; Laura hyperventilated).
Party decides to enter cave/approach boulder; group will continue stealthing. Some brief delays (personal needs) before proceeding. (turns 705-711,706,710,698-704)

Grog/Travis found a Parapet of Wound Closure (magic item) and offers it to Vex as trade for a necklace/deck; item reportedly does not require attunement per Grog, but Vex skeptical; Grog promises not to use/look at the deck and transfers cards into a pouch. (turns 715-745)
Trade: Vex traded Parapet of Wound Closure to Grog for his deck; Grog promised not to look at deck while Vex nearby; deck returned to Grog (turns 752-770,776-780).

Keyleth used Stone Shape (4th-level) to create a small opening (~<=5 ft) in boulder; opening allows arm reach and a view ~100 ft into a dark tunnel that curves left and descends; Oracle Arrow (Nat20) showed heavy dust, no tracks/movement, silent (turns 783-800,805-811).

Party notes concern about making noise: Raishan likely has good hearing; options discussed: be stealthy, use another 4th-level Stone Shape to finish, Grog offers brute force; mention of siege gauntlets as possible tool (turns 812-822).

Keyleth used Stone Shape (4th-level) to create a small opening (~<=5 ft) in boulder; opening allows arm reach and a view ~100 ft into dark tunnel that curves left and descends; Oracle Arrow (Nat20) showed heavy dust, no tracks/movement, silent. Group discussing next steps: use another Stone Shape, have Grog force/lever boulder, or use Oil of Etherealness on Scanlan/Pike to pass through rock. Fingerholds visible—dragon-sized—suggest boulder was jammed by a creature. (turns 783-811,823-892)

Options considered to move/enter through boulder: carve thin rim with Stone Shape (additional 4th-level spell), brute force with Grog (siege gauntlets), construct lever using Kima's long sword as pry (Kima warns about damage), or use Oil of Etherealness to pass through rock (insufficient quantity to cover Percy). No switches found; investigation by Travis rolled 17. (turns 812-892)

Group wedged boulder ~1.5 ft open using Grog+party strength and two Immovable Rods; rods holding though slowly moving (each rod 8,000 lbs). Party entered tunnel; boulder currently stationary but wedged. (turns 898-925)

Tunnel interior: 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall carved passage, descending curve, still air, layer of dust, smell of rot/stagnant water. Floor peppered with small porous, lighter shards—identified as charred bone fragments. (turns 933-947)

Attempt to lever boulder: group strength checks succeeded (notable rolls: Grog 23, Pike aided); Trinket helped (19). Kerrek suggested using Immovable Rods to brace; rods inserted into dragon-sized finger-holes to lock boulder. (turns 898-921)

Party wedged boulder ~1.5 ft open using Grog+party strength and two Immovable Rods; rods holding though slowly moving (each rod 8,000 lbs). Party entered tunnel; boulder currently stationary but wedged. (turns 898-925). Confirmed continued descent into tunnel and no traps presently. (turns 919,958)

Tunnel interior: 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall carved passage, descending curve, still air, layer of dust, smell of rot/stagnant water. Floor peppered with small porous, lighter shards—identified as charred bone fragments. Nature check (Marisha) 28: bones are years old (not ancient) with dust layer—untouched for short time. Thordak used lair here historically. (turns 933-947,979-986)

Pike cast Death Ward on Vex (4th-level) — effect active for next 8 hours (Vex will drop to 1 HP instead of 0 once). Percival and Kerrek currently blind; party rolled stealth again with high results; no traps detected at present. (turns 999-1001,1020)
Kerrek put arm around Grog; party linked arms for stealth; Vax's dagger flame provides ~60 ft light for him, ~15 ft otherwise; Kerrek comforted by Grog (turns 1045-1048,1053-1056,1072-1078).

Tunnel wall alcoves every ~20 ft with shelves containing melted candles, skulls, small books, wooden boxes; one alcove held a mummified raccoon-like creature. Party made perception/investigation checks (Vax 29 then 22; Investigation 22 for box: not trapped). (turns 1054-1060,1069-1088,1094-1096).

Group wedged boulder ~1.5 ft open using Grog+party strength and two Immovable Rods; rods holding though slowly moving (each rod 8,000 lbs). Party entered tunnel; boulder currently stationary but wedged. (turns 898-925,919).
Kerrek used Divine Sense; sensed an undead presence to the left, originating from a wall alcove/shelf (not directionally precise but left of party). (turns 1102,1106,1126)
Grog moved toward left alcove where two melted candles and a singed human skull sat on a shelf; Kerrek confirmed undead was 'over there'. (turns 1136,1137,1141,1149,1152)
Kerrek asked if skull could be an undead watcher/spy; religion check (~12) yielded general lore: undead can raise/control dead; possible situational uses (watcher/security). (turns 1153-1159)
Kerrek used Divine Sense and identified the skull as the source of undead energy; skull not reacting while held. (turn 1165)
Kerrek placed the skull in a heavy burlap sack, tied it, and set it on the shelf facing the wall to avoid it 'looking' at the party. (turn 1191)

Party continues deeper: entered hexagonal chamber ~25 ft high with a dark green marble pillar holding an iron bowl/dish ~5–6 ft up on a dais; right-side shelf holds a very large leather-bound tome and an unlit cold-iron brazier with dried tinder. (turns 1199-1210)

Party in hexagonal chamber: iron bowl/pillar center, raised platform, large iron door opposite, brazier and large leather-bound tome on right shelf. No visible ceiling mechanisms or wall levers; room shows old stone masonry and minor cave-ins. (turns 1239-1246,1249-1256)

Investigation of iron bowl: faint long-dried residue scraped into dark burgundy powder; tastes iron-like — identified as old blood. Suggestion/joke to bleed into bowl to open door noted. (turns 1257-1266,1282-1292)
Grog inspects tome: large, thick leather cover; unclear if tanned hide or flesh due to light. (turns 1296-1301)

Book on shelf: pages/text contract/shrink when viewed or when illuminated; appears unreadable up close or under bright light; low-light observation might help. Observed by Vax, Allura, Kerrek; confirmed when Kerrek activated hammer light and text shrank further. (turns 1339-1365)
Room lighting: iron brazier with dried tinder present; extinguishing/altering light affects book legibility; Allura reacted to light change. (turns 1310-1313,1361-1372)
Kerrek activated hammer that produces radiant light (artifact-like); bright light causes book text to shrink/become dot-like; hammer makes noticeable sound. (turns 1355-1361)

Book on shelf: pages/text contract/shrink when viewed or when illuminated; appears unreadable up close or under bright light; low-light observation might help. Book was later destroyed by brazier explosion when Keyleth lit it. (turns 1339-1365,1427)

Kerrek activated hammer that produces radiant light (artifact-like); bright light causes book text to shrink/become dot-like; hammer head flickered out after use leaving handle. Kerrek failed dex save in explosion. (turns 1355-1361,1373-1411)

Room lighting: iron brazier with extremely explosive materials hidden in kindling; lighting it caused a large explosion damaging party and destroying the book; brazier now bent/ruined. (turns 1310-1313,1377-1415,1427)
Book destroyed: Keyleth/lighting the brazier caused explosion that burned book; earlier noted property of shrinking text confirmed before destruction. (turns 1427,1468-1470)

Basilisk-blood mechanism: adding party blood pulled drops beneath surface; a few drops didn't open door, but when more blood added the metallic door fully lifted after bowl glowed and blood sizzled; party took 1 point damage from blood. (turns 1451-1470)

Encounter start: upon opening door, multiple flaming/flare skulls (4 total) approached from both hallway sides; Pike cast Holy Aura activating 30-ft radiant protective circle; initiative rolled—multiple nat20s (Scanlan, Keyleth). Combat begun. (turns 1472-1490,1498-1508)

Combat: party circled around Pike; skulls (4 total) entering chamber from raised gate; Scanlan and Vax acted first; Vax threw two daggers (hits) dealing 19 and 10; Keyleth cast Moonbeam (5-ft radius, concentration) hitting two skulls for 13 radiant each; some skulls visibly damaged but remain. (turns 1516-1588)

Actions/positions: Scanlan and Vax moved to opposite walls; Vax flew 10 ft in air; Scanlan and Vax targeted skulls on their side; Keyleth and Kerrek positioned flanking Allura near northern area; Pike in center. (turns 1530-1546,1571)

Four flame skulls fired simultaneous red-beam Fireballs causing four separate explosions centered on room; group suffered multiple Dex saves with advantage (Scanlan exempt). Several characters saved all; damages: Keyleth saved all (now 50 HP), Vax evaded (0), Vex saved all (57 HP), Percy took 56 fire (now at HP reflected), Pike failed two then halved by resistance (44), Grog failed two/ took 88 then halved? (turns 1595-1680).

Trinket saved only one explosion and was placed back in Pike's necklace. Kerrek (Patrick) made all saves. Matt adjusted/clarified damage numbers mid-resolution (conflicting stated numbers: 76/72/48/56/70/88) — final settled values used in play as described. (turns 1638-1679)
Combat: Percival (scanlan's gun?) used Animus with sharpshooter/deadeye to kill two skull constructs; regained grit points. (turns 1690-1718)

Patrick's Aura of Divinity: grants +3 to saves for allies 'close to me' (charisma bonus); would have changed prior failed saves — would have saved Pike and possibly Grog (would have reduced damage by 11 per failed save). (turns 1722-1734,1736-1742)
Trinket failed three saving throws even with potential +3 aura; Grog's rolls: 10,10,21,21 noted—would have made one 13 threshold with aura? (turns 1735-1746)
